pages.name: KIRO Agent Discovery (Dec 21)
pages.description_html:
KIRO Agent Deep Dive

The Moment Everything Changed

Started expecting ~2,000 Copilot chats. Found 125,413 pre-computed vectors in SQLite!

Data Inventory

.manifest files: 13,791  - LanceDB metadata
.txn files:      13,779  - LanceDB transaction logs
.chat files:     13,222  - Chat conversations
.lance files:     6,078  - LanceDB vector tables
.js files:        4,084  - Code files
.tsx files:       1,965  - React TypeScript

SQLite Schema (index.sqlite)

CREATE TABLE lance_db_cache (
    uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    cacheKey TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    vector TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 384-dim embedding
    startLine INTEGER NOT NULL,
    endLine INTEGER NOT NULL,
    contents TEXT NOT NULL
);

Buffer Overflow Crisis

Error: offset out of range. It must be >= 0 && <= 17825792. Received 17825794

Root Cause: 10,825 files × 350KB = ~2GB (V8 limit ~1GB)

Solution:

  1. Streaming: 50 files/batch
  2. Garbage collection: node --expose-gc
  3. MongoDB chunking: 500 sessions/doc

Result: 37,698 exchanges recovered (73.7% of total)

Vector Import Stats

  • 125,413 vectors at 908/sec
  • 138 seconds total
  • 0 failures

Key Insight

KIRO was 36x more active than Copilot! (49,775 vs 1,385 exchanges)

pages.name: MongoDB Import (Dec 25)
pages.description_html:
MongoDB Import Session

The Situation

Christmas Day. 4.7GB exports on laptop. Docker MongoDB empty.

Options Evaluated

ApproachVerdict
Node.js script❌ Slow, memory issues
mongo shell load()❌ Crashes on large files
mongoimport CLI✅ Native, fast

Methodology

docker cp exports/*.json container:/tmp/
docker exec container mongoimport \
  --uri mongodb://localhost:27017/secondbrain \
  --collection X \
  --file /tmp/X.json \
  --jsonArray

Results

CollectionDocsSizeTime
conversations99165MB~4s
deepdivelogs2,3946.2MB~0.4s
neuralarchives25.1KB~0.2s
projectslists10156KB~0.2s
rawconversations13,5204.25GB~60s
TOTAL16,1164.7GB~65s

Key Decisions

  • Why /tmp/? Guaranteed writable, auto-cleaned on restart
  • Why --jsonArray? Our exports are [{}, {}] not NDJSON
  • Why mongoimport? Native tool, no custom parsing, 100% success

pages.name: Vertex AI Batch Pipeline
pages.description_html:
Vertex AI Batch Pipeline

The Problem

  • 13,520 documents (4.32GB)
  • Online API: 5 RPM rate limit
  • Groq: 100k tokens/day blocked at 90%

The Solution: Batch API

  • 50% discount vs online API
  • No rate limits
  • Implicit caching: 90% on repeated tokens

Debugging Journey

Error 1: Model 404

NOT_FOUND: gemini-2.5-flash-001 does not exist

Root Cause: Preview models need full suffix

Fix: Use gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20

Error 2: Bucket 404

Fix: Auto-create bucket if missing

Node.js Implementation

// Model Resource Format
const model = 'publishers/google/models/gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20';

// Endpoint must specify region
const endpoint = `${LOCATION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com`;

// Input payload format
{
  "contents": [{ "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] }],
  "generation_config": { "temperature": 0.2 }
}

Idempotency

  1. Content hash in .batch_meta.json
  2. GCS size verification
  3. Job state tracking

Results

MetricValue
Documents13,520
Data Size4.32GB
Cost Savings~50%

pages.name: Plane Self-Host Setup (Dec 27)
pages.description_html:
Plane Self-Host Setup

Services (8 containers)

  • plane-api - Django (port 3006→8000)
  • plane-web - Next.js (port 3005→3000)
  • plane-db - Postgres 15
  • plane-redis - Redis 7
  • plane-minio - S3 storage (9000/9001)
  • plane-edge - nginx proxy
  • db-backup - pg_dump every 24h
  • minio-backup - mc mirror every 24h

The 401 Problem

UI stuck on welcome screen. Console showed:

GET /api/users/me/ 401 Unauthorized

Root Cause

Instance flags: is_setup_done=False, no instance admin linked.

The Fix

  1. python manage.py create_instance_admin email@example.com
  2. Django shell: inst.is_setup_done=True; inst.save()
  3. Edge rewrite for /god-mode/*

Backup Config

  • Postgres: pg_dump every 24h to backups/db/
  • MinIO: mc mirror every 24h to backups/minio/
  • Logs: json-file driver, 10MB chunks, 5 files

Volumes

  • pgdata - Postgres files
  • redisdata - RDB snapshots
  • uploads - MinIO bucket

CRISIS (Dec 21): Large KIRO workspaces crashed extraction.

Error

offset out of range. It must be >= 0 && <= 17825792. Received 17825794

Root Cause

10,825 files × 350KB = ~2GB (V8 string limit ~1GB)

Solution

  1. Streaming: 50 files/batch
  2. node --expose-gc + manual gc()
  3. MongoDB chunking: 500 sessions/doc

Result

37,698 exchanges recovered (73.7% of total)

issues.name: MongoDB 16MB document limit - chunking solution
issues.description_html:
Problem: 5,947 sessions in single document → 17.8MB (exceeds 16MB limit)

Solution

Split into 500 sessions per document:

  • Workspace 7281... → 12 MongoDB documents
  • Workspace 8856... → 10 MongoDB documents

Total: 22 documents for 10,825 sessions
